_about: Every record-data defect the card steps (docs/card-design.md, 2026-10-02 → 2026-10-09) surfaced and deliberately did NOT fix on the display side: the card shows the page as printed and lists the record here for the rebuild lane (overlay rows through scripts/apply-parity-fixes.mjs, then ONE npm run data when the other lane's regen is committed). Ruling R12: the newest printing wins, whole. Mechanics (engine numbers) are out of scope on the card, so the engine entries below are the lane's to fix, not the card's.

wands.wand-of-refracting-rays-7th-rank: Foundry's mislabelled 6th-rank copy; parity-fix spec at work/wand-refracting-rays-fix.json (dry run accepted 2026-10-04); its field Usage/Price rows print on no page (card-truth EXTRA).
wands.duplicateRankWands: 39 duplicate '(Nth-Rank)' wand records need a computed rule rather than per-record rows (memory: project_hh_display_truth_2026_10_02).

weaponGroupDrift._from: work/card-step14-weapon-group-drift.json (step 14 round 2): the record's group is a group the weapon's own page never prints; the card shows the page's embedded group effect and hides ours.

heighteningDrift._from: work/card-step17-heighten-reprint-drift.json (step 17 rounds 1-3): the spell's engine heightening (public/core.json heightening fields) disagrees with the newest printing; the card withholds or re-counts the arrow (displaySuppressed) and shows the page's numbers; the engine still computes the old ones.

printedInsideAnotherPage._what: spell records whose Archives page is a feat / rules / hazard page (the record is printed inside it); the card shows our text with a 'Printed inside <title>' footer until the spells surface draws slices (step 12's slice tables extended to spells).

actionCost._from: test/card-action.test.tsx PRINT_DIFFERS (step 9): the stored action cost is not the page's printed title glyph; the card header reads the page's glyph and draws ours beside it, marked.

dataFixes._what: the page prints ONE cost and the record stores another: plain record errors.
dataFixes.classFeatures/drain-life: printed Single Action, stored Two Actions
dataFixes.classFeatures/for-talmandor-for-freedom: printed Two Actions, stored One Action
dataFixes.feats/death-from-above-eternal-legend: printed Single Action, stored Two Actions

variableCost._what: the page prints a RANGE or an EITHER/OR cost that the engine's single cost field cannot hold: an engine-shape decision (a cost range), not a data row. Mechanics are out of scope on the card; the card already shows the printed glyph.
variableCost.classFeatures/act-together: printed Single Action to Three Actions, stored One Action
variableCost.classFeatures/shadows-in-the-moonlight: printed Single Action or Two Actions, stored One Action
variableCost.feats/aon-dad-joke: printed Single Action to Two Actions, stored One Action
variableCost.feats/body-of-air: printed Reaction or Two Actions, stored Reaction
variableCost.feats/bullet-and-a-broadside: printed Single Action or Two Actions, stored One Action
variableCost.feats/marine-jet: printed Two Actions or Three Actions, stored Two Actions
variableCost.feats/sheltering-hand: printed Single Action or Two Actions, stored One Action

wrongAonId._from: archive-coverage settle round (2026-10-09): player-bucket records whose aonId is a CREATURE page, so their card draws a creature-family page.

mirrorDefects._what: wrong printing links in the AoN mirror itself (not our data); listed in src/data/stub-names.json _notes.
mirrorDefects.action-902: 'Explode' (Guns & Gears Remastered) carries legacy_id action-3666 'Interact'; its own Guns & Gears printing action-3656 has no link either way, so the stub stays a plain name.

spellFields: spell duration / area / range fields that the page prints differently from the record (step 16: the card draws the page's rows, the record's fields stay for the engine) — the ledger's spellDetail EXTRA/DIFFERS lists in scripts/data/card-truth-baseline.json name them.

sliceGaps.earth-gate: Earth Gate got no page slice although its element page has Air's shape (step 12 known).
